description: GET any TDX API path (https://tdx.transportdata.tw/api-service/swagger) with OData options. Use it only when no specific tool covers the data. Field names in filter, select and orderBy are TDX field names (e.g. StationName/Zh_tw). Results are not cached and null or empty fields are dropped. Example: path "/v2/Rail/THSR/Station", select ["StationID","StationName"], top 5.

filter.description: OData $filter, e.g. "AvailableRentBikes gt 0 and contains(StationName/Zh_tw,'捷運')".

orderBy.description: Sort keys ($orderby), each "Field" or "Field desc", e.g. ["UpdateTime desc"].

path.description: API path starting with a version, e.g. /v2/Bike/Station/City/Taipei.

name: tdx_get
title: Query any TDX endpoint
